key_insight: ScoutRoute uses internal signals from one inexpensive scout-model forward pass to predict which independently trained language model is best suited to a task.
engineering_relevance: It enables lightweight, post-hoc routing across heterogeneous LLMs without modifying the underlying models or running every expert.
method: Extract hidden-state representations and logit-derived confidence from a scout model.
Use lightweight logistic probes to estimate competence across expert models.
Combine competence estimates and confidence signals in domain-aware expert selection.
evidence_signal: Across five open-weight models and four benchmarks spanning math, code, commonsense, and multidisciplinary knowledge, ScoutRoute outperformed individual routing signals, while its competence probes showed better calibration than conventional confidence measures.
watch_item: The abstract does not quantify routing gains or latency savings, leaving deployment trade-offs unclear.
paper_title: ScoutRoute: Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Routing Using Internal Language Model Signals
